name: frogent-drug-design
description: Connect FROGENT biomedical research and drug-design skills to scientific MCP services.

interface.longDescription: Research biomedical literature, apply scientific and medicinal-chemistry judgment, prioritize design hypotheses, calibrate them with tools, optimize molecules and peptides, and plan experiments with a policy-controlled FROGENT harness.
defaultPrompt: Discover a target and propose candidate ligands.
Research a biomedical question with a traceable evidence review.
Evaluate docking and ADMET evidence for my molecules.
Use medicinal-chemistry judgment to prioritize what I should synthesize next.
Optimize a peptide against a protein target.
